strongs_1890.strongs_def: elevation, i.e. the act (literally, a journey to a higher place, figuratively, a thought arising), or (concretely) the condition (literally, a step or grademark, figuratively, a superiority of station); specifically a climactic progression (in certain Psalms)
strongs_1890.kjv_def: things that come up, (high) degree, deal, go up, stair, step, story.
